patch_description: This crossover keeps the current implementation’s concave direct-link reward and the stronger, demand-sensitive two-hop support used by the better-performing variants. It adopts the inspiration program’s stronger path coefficient and its discount for component links with direct demand, while using a concave, capped path-support adjustment so moderate-demand OD pairs can still influence transit choices. Transit-node pressure discourages overusing busy intermediates. The quadratic terms remain limited to two-link paths, and degree penalties are left to the evaluator.
